sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:201

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:201:1
items.html: Half of the right in the Yesod of Aba, and half of the left in the Yesod of Ima, and so on, and they were all given within Ima: This has already been explained at length in the previous part, that on the first day of the days of absorption, the right line of ZA was corrected through the coupling of AVI that is in Aba, and on the second day the left line was corrected through AVI that is in Ima, and on the third day the middle line was corrected through both of them together. Study it there well. And corresponding to them, MA was also corrected — and indeed MA corrects BON, for the discernment of the level of the coupling, and likewise the new vessels that come with the level of the coupling, are called by the name MA. And according to its level in lights and vessels, so is corrected from BON, as above in the previous parts. And therefore it is found that the measures of the lights and vessels of MA necessarily rise together with the vessels of BON.
